result.summary: The page is largely well-formed; one notable issue is the notification/profile icon in the top right showing an empty gray circle with a red dot but no icon or avatar image inside it.

issues.description: The top-right circular avatar/notification icon appears blank (empty gray circle) with only a red notification dot, missing a profile image or icon glyph.
issues.suggestion: Add a default user avatar icon or placeholder image inside the circle so it doesn't appear broken or empty.
